items.title: Muhammad Ali: speed, voice and legacy

source.topic: Muhammad Ali and his public legacy
source.source_text: Muhammad Ali became known not only for movement and speed in the ring, but also for the confidence with which he spoke in public. The documentary must distinguish sporting analysis from broader cultural interpretation.

segments.source_text: ALI-SOURCE-01. Explain movement, distance and rhythm.
ALI-SOURCE-02. Explain how public communication became part of his image.
ALI-SOURCE-03. Explain the difference between sporting legacy and cultural memory.
